pages.text: The sun went down, and the shop closed. Today Coco was in charge of tidying up.
Cutters in their place, cups in theirs. Coco began carrying things one at a time.
Mr. Pig stopped by as he passed. "Here's how to do it!" He brought a big tub.
He swept his arm across the table. Clatter! Everything fell into the tub.
"Done! Quick, wasn't it?" He dusted off his hands.
Mom needed a cup. She had to search in the tub for a long time.
The cutters for tomorrow morning were at the bottom too, tangled with stirrers and towels.
Coco tipped the tub and gently poured everything out. Then each thing went back in its place.
Cutters in their place, cups in theirs. The shelves grew neat and tidy.
All done! Mr. Pig held the empty tub and tilted his head. "My way was quicker, though."
